purpose: 探索实时对话操控任意内容画布的五种交互组织方式

concepts.name: 无界工作台
concepts.description: 语音直接摆放、关联、缩放网页、视频和文件。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 1 — BOUNDLESS DESK / FREEFORM DIRECT MANIPULATION.
Invent a true borderless 2D infinite workspace. Asymmetric expansive composition: a large live web page at x roughly 120–720, y 150–570, with clean editorial architecture imagery and readable headline "光与空间"; a separate larger widescreen video surface at x 800–1400, y 290–670, displaying moving light across a modern concrete interior, discreet playback controls along its own lower edge. A smaller PDF page titled "项目方案" floats loosely beneath the website, and a slim task progress note is above the video. Deliberately varied sizes and coordinates; no tile grid, no fixed sidebar, no uniform card row. Each object has barely-there floating glass chrome, a title and a tiny expand control; the actual website, video, and PDF contents remain readable. The website and video are currently being arranged together: a very fine cyan selection edge and one unobtrusive insertion guide express the voice operation. A tiny two-stroke silver AI glyph at lower-left sits next to a short unboxed transcript "把网页和视频放一起，放大对比" and small "实时对话" status plus mute icon. Minimal "norma" wordmark top-left and "100%" zoom top-right. There must be lots of breathing room between objects and at the canvas edges. Subtle ice-blue glass, mostly black, white, and photographic architecture. It feels like a living desktop the user can speak objects into, not a dashboard.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-end speculative desktop UI concept image for Norma, a live voice-controlled infinite canvas capable of displaying and manipulating websites, PDFs, photos, video, code, and live tasks. Show an actual active working session: the user is speaking, and the canvas visibly reflects the requested operation. The screen must communicate a new spatial interaction model, not merely a new assistant mascot.
Asset type: a crisp complete landscape app screenshot, directly viewed flat-on, no laptop, no physical room, no presentation board or mockup framing. Wide desktop proportions approximately 16:10.
Art direction: daring yet exceptionally simple, serene future computing, deep black surroundings, precise Apple-like translucent optical materials, excellent hierarchy and system sans-serif typography. Small, sharp Chinese interface labels, meaningful imagery and true content detail. Colored light is minimal and purposeful. Fewer controls, generous spacing, radically content-first. Sophisticated glass catches light only at fine edges; avoid chunky rounded cards and gray gradients everywhere. Real content surfaces can use whatever background they require. Retain ample black negative space around content.
The AI is a small integrated live presence that moves with the task or lives at an unobtrusive edge. NOT a large central orb, not a hero illustration. No central "我在听" greeting composition, no two identical utility cards under an AI avatar, no full-width bottom search/input field. Speech status, a short live transcription, and a tiny stop/mute affordance suffice. Show voice manipulating content, not a text chatbot with a wallpaper.
Avoid: dashboards, sci-fi HUD greebles, dense telemetry, decorative stars or galaxies, concentric ripples, decorative grids, opaque application chrome, oversized logos, excessive glow, fake code noise, giant assistant face, watermarks, comparison montages. Do not write a concept number or concept title as a poster headline. This is a believable usable next-generation product interface, not a generic Dribbble marketing page.

concepts.name: 沉浸剧场
concepts.description: 内容占满视野，AI 缩到边角，其他材料收成侧边缩略片。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 2 — CONTENT THEATER / IMMERSIVE FOCUS.
A radically immersive screen dominated by one giant nearly edge-to-edge video of a monochrome windswept desert, an architectural pavilion and dramatic late-day light. Cinematic, exquisite photography, strong black shadows, large beautiful quiet areas. The video IS the working canvas, not an image inside a thick card, no box around it. Its restrained title "空间影像" appears at top-left with a tiny back-to-canvas control. On the far right, an extremely slim floating stack of three translucent thumbnails shows a companion PDF, a website, and a reference image, enough to recall them without sacrificing the main content. At lower-left, separated from any meaningful image content by the composition, a tiny luminous pearl-white vertical voice filament and an elegant small optical-glass speech capsule show "全屏播放，资料收到右边" and "实时对话". Main video playback controls are a fine hairline scrubber and a small play icon at bottom; assistant does not sit over these controls. No normal header bar, no input bar, no central avatar, no dashboard. Content-first immersive future cinema, black and pearl, warm desaturated stone in the imagery, no neon. Make the voice command visibly responsible for the companions being tucked at the right edge.

concepts.name: 语义星图
concepts.description: 素材按关系组织，语音连接内容并生成新节点。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 3 — SEMANTIC CONSTELLATION / RELATIONAL CANVAS.
A sophisticated black infinite canvas where heterogeneous real content is organized by meaning in a sparse elegant spatial graph. Readable selected synthesized document on the center-right, roughly 430px wide and 460px tall, displaying heading "空间设计提案", a short clean paragraph, a large editorial architecture image, and a few simple section labels. On the left, three smaller beautifully rendered source nodes float at DIFFERENT coordinates: a live website thumbnail upper-left titled "参考网页"; a photo node middle-left titled "材质"; a video frame bottom-left titled "影像". One tiny file node at top-center reads "Brief.pdf". Two or three very fine pearlescent curved connectors connect these source surfaces to the selected document; connections express provenance, not a technical workflow diagram. One short connection glows in restrained violet-white as synthesis completes. A minimal tiny luminous cursor-shaped AI presence lives right beside the selected document's left margin, with a short hovering transcript "把这些资料整理成一份方案"; a small "生成中" label is anchored to the document edge. A subtle return / mute capsule at extreme lower-left. Top-left modest "norma" wordmark, top-right a small overview icon. Elegant information architecture with very large black spaces, legible content, exquisite fine glass edges, minimal lavender and silver. No celestial imagery despite the conceptual constellation; no circles full of icons, no server architecture diagram, no central AI orb.

concepts.name: 共创长卷
concepts.description: 对话沿画布留下轨迹，文字、图片和视频组成可编辑内容。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 4 — LIVING MANUSCRIPT / CONVERSATIONAL CO-CREATION.
Reimagine the workspace as a continuous editorial canvas that grows as the user speaks, rather than a collection of windows. The right three-quarters of the screen contains one spacious borderless authored document on black, no enclosing card: a large typographic title "未来的居住方式", one calm introduction paragraph in pearl-white, a generous two-image editorial spread of sunlit modern architecture and a tactile material close-up, followed by a wide inline video strip with a play symbol and a short caption. The screen crops the next section slightly at the bottom, suggesting an infinitely extensible vertical canvas. Beautiful editorial asymmetric alignment, legible, sophisticated visual rhythm, warm-neutral photography, graphite and ivory palette. On the far left, a narrow quiet conversation margin: THREE short spoken-turn annotations at different vertical positions, subtly aligned to the content they caused, "收集参考", "整理成方案", "加入这段视频". These are small annotations, not large chat bubbles, and no chatbot sidebar boundary. Near the active last annotation is a tiny silver sound-shaped AI mark with live transcript "把图片和视频编成一页方案" and "实时对话"; a tiny white caret in the canvas's next section indicates editing as the voice continues. Top-left a very small Norma mark; top-right only export and overview icons. Huge margin space, floating editorial content, the assistant accompanies the work instead of occupying the center. This must look radically different from the freeform desktop and graph concepts.

concepts.name: 折叠空间
concepts.description: 每组内容成为独立空间，用对话切换、展开或合并。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 5 — FOLDED SPACES / ZOOMABLE MULTIPLE WORLDS.
Invent a sparse 2.5D workspace overview with THREE large live canvas islands floating across a black void at subtly different depths, like folding transparent panes of a spatial operating system. NO physical room and no headset, it is directly an app screenshot. Center-right is the active island, the largest, mostly front-facing with a slight 5 degree perspective, title "当前项目" and within it two integrated actual content surfaces: an architecture video and a narrow readable plan document, connected by a tiny task progress strip. On far left, a smaller receding angled pane titled "灵感" contains a beautiful two-photo composition and one website preview, with lots of open space. At upper-right behind the active island, a small receding pane titled "资料" contains a PDF and a clean note. The panes are near-invisible optical-glass boundaries enclosing distinct freely organized workspaces, not screenshots of browser tabs, not whiteboards full of dozens of tiles, not a carousel of static covers. Ample black space and strong clear depth separation. One fine white focus path sweeps toward the active workspace, the only intentional line in the background. Along the bottom-left edge a tiny low glowing silver slit, an unboxed live transcript "打开灵感空间，把参考图带过来", and a single small mute button form the entire assistant. A small reference photo is visible half-way between the left and active islands as the one frozen visual clue to spoken transfer. The active island has a discreet expand icon, demonstrating any workspace can become full-screen. Materials black titanium and colorless optical glass, restrained glints of blue-white at the focal plane only, photo colors natural. Bold, calm future multitasking, a completely different spatial organization from a conventional assistant page.
